## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify the flavour of a [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) — factual, temporal, numeric, or framing — from the [`gmeow:ContradictionKind`](../classes/gmeow-ContradictionKind.md) vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting several kinds on one contradiction (it is functional — split a multi-flavour conflict into separate [`Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) individuals) and avoid reading a framing kind as factual conflict; framing is often standpoint difference, not disagreement about fact.

### How to use

- Assert exactly one [`gmeow:contradictionKind`](gmeow-contradictionKind.md) per [`Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) at a [`gmeow:ContradictionKind`](../classes/gmeow-ContradictionKind.md) individual; mint a fresh kind if a needed flavour is not seeded, since the vocabulary is open.
